notes.title: Patch 1.46.4
notes.content:
[code]
########
# 1.46.4 Patch Notes 
########
- Fix for soft lock after adding models to cart from a user profile.
- Fix for item count and total price not being updated correctly when removing items from cart in some instances.
- Fix for published models being spontaneously unpublished after editing titles and/or descriptions.
- Fix for missing selection border on model shop item panels.
- Minor UI tweaks such as reducing the gap between a selected world or model and its associated detail panel.
[/code]

notes.title: Patch 1.46.3
notes.content:
[code]
########
# 1.46.3 Patch Notes 
########
- Do you have a Blocksworld account on iPhone or iPad? Now you can link your Steam Blocksworld account to your iOS one!
- We've added model publishing! If you've got a model you're really proud of, you can publish it for other players to buy!
- You can also buy additional blocks from the new Shop menu!
- You'll need some coins to go shopping, though! You can earn them by creating popular worlds!
- Squished and squashed a few user interface bugs.
[/code]

notes.title: Patch 1.45.0
notes.content:
[code]
########
# 1.45.0 Patch Notes 
########
- Removed publication world limits — you can now publish more than 5 worlds!
- Added world publication cooldown: 1 publish per 24 hours, republish a single world within the hour.
- Added world star ratings to bring more nuanced feedback for the worlds you play!
- Publishing changes is now more responsive to edits to titles, descriptions, and categories
- Laid groundwork for model publishing:  added model preview terrain type selection and category selection.
- Pressing escape from text input fields now correctly saves the edits.
- Your scroll position is now remembered in the play browser when exiting worlds.
- Improved the error handling for world publication, specifically for profanity check failures.
- The skybox now properly reverts to existing settings when dragging a texture back off the sky to the build panel.
- Skybox texture memory usage has been greatly improved.
[/code]

notes.title: Patch 1.44.6
